look: XORA site look, same as T01: deep void ground, frosted glass panels, clean generic phone mock-ups of the XORA app (fictional numbers), the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson twenty-six
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 6 XORA Intelligence, lesson T26 Understanding AI decisions; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Three answers
scenes.desc: A phone mock cycles the verdict BUY, SELL, NO TRADE: results of rule-based checks, not predictions.

scenes.name: BUY, SHORT or wait
scenes.desc: Three cards: BUY (long) gains if price rises, SHORT if it falls, NO TRADE stands aside; a plan lasts one candle.

scenes.name: Rules, not guesses
scenes.desc: Coin data flows through yes/no checks that tick or cross; techniques the filters draw on.

scenes.name: What confidence means
scenes.desc: Confirmations that agree fill a score bar; disagreeing or missing checks add nothing.

scenes.name: The entry checklist
scenes.desc: ENTRY CHECKLIST mock: BUY 72% / 60% READY, SELL 55% / 60% not ready.

scenes.name: Not a chance of winning
scenes.desc: Misconception 72% = chance to win is crossed out; evidence strength, not a chance of winning.

scenes.name: Safety checks
scenes.desc: A READY setup meets safety gates; spread too wide closes a gate: No trade.

scenes.name: Uncertainty and NO TRADE
scenes.desc: A choppy range, checks disagree, No trade with reasons; waiting is a good outcome.

scenes.name: Your confidence setting
scenes.desc: Trade Settings mock: Enter only at or above 50%; higher needs more confirmation; 45% is the chart-pattern route; Basic / Secure / Advanced.

scenes.name: Approve, auto or manual
scenes.desc: Approve buy countdown, auto approval toggle, and the manual BUY sheet saying whether the engine agrees.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause: BUY 68% / 70%, what happens? Answer: no READY, no trade.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: No guaranteed profits, rules can be wrong, slippage, fees, leverage; demo first; not financial advice.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three points and a check question.
